bullets.title: How Taylor Tomlinson Nailed the Closing Joke in her Netflix Special
bullets.note: This text-plus-video feature shows how comic Taylor Tomlinson spent a year workshopping the closing joke of her Netflix special. It’s incredible that all of this was captured and woven together. As they say, writing is rewriting. This is true for nearly everything. In the world of tech, Steve Blank has said, “No plan survives first contact with customers.” Same same. Quality begins with a shitty first draft, so just get started and take the punches. That’s how you press the carbon into diamonds: pressure and time.

bullets.title: A former church girl’s search for a new spiritual home
bullets.note:
Sex, drugs, and Pentecostals? Doms and dungeons? You betcha. Not for the faint of heart. There’s something in this that will make nearly everyone uncomfortable.  
​  
I strongly suggest you feel the discomfort and ride it through. Think of it as an auditory BDSM meditation. There are quite a few gems sprinkled throughout. Sometimes “life begins at the end of your comfort zone” (Neal Donald Walsch), so you might as well get some practice.

bullets.title: Anatomy Of A Twitter/X Account Takeover Hack
bullets.note:
If Fred Wilson can get caught, so can you, and this short post is a great reminder.  
​**​  
NOTE ON TWO CURRENT TIM FERRISS SCAMS:  
​**First, there are multiple scammers emailing people from “The Tim Ferriss Show,” offering to pay them to appear on the podcast. These are all a scam. I don’t pay people to appear, and no one has ever paid me to appear on the show. The grift appears to be this: they eventually get you on a Zoom call, have you share your screen, then either take over your Facebook page (possibly to drain crypto wallets with fake offerings) or convince you to “pay a small fee to join an event.” I know that scammers are also claiming to represent Rich Roll, Lewis Howes, and many others. Don’t fall for it. I’m not aware of a single large or credible podcast that will pay you to appear as a guest.  
​  
Second, there are imitators with fake TF accounts DMing people on Instagram. That’s not me, folks. My only real account is [@timferriss](https://www.instagram.com/timferriss/) on Instagram.
